# Force complete reload
import sys

# Remove ALL semver modules
mods_to_remove = [k for k in sys.modules if 'semver' in k]
for m in mods_to_remove:
    del sys.modules[m]

# Also remove any compiled .pyc files
import os, glob
for pyc in glob.glob('src/semver/__pycache__/*.pyc'):
    os.remove(pyc)

# Now import fresh
sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
from semver.version import Version

# Test _increment_string directly
print("_increment_string('rc.9'):", Version._increment_string('rc.9'))
print("_increment_string('rc9'):", Version._increment_string('rc9'))
print("_increment_string('alpha'):", Version._increment_string('alpha'))

# Now test bump_prerelease
v2 = Version.parse('1.0.0-rc.9')
result2 = v2.bump_prerelease()
print(f"rc.9 bump_prerelease: {result2}")
